caption: The drawing is divided into two sections by a vertical line, with "LONG ISLAND MOHEGAN" written vertically along the dividing line and also horizontally at the top of each section. On the left side, there is a colored drawing of a horn with the label "LENGTH 13 INS." The horn is brown with darker brown bands and decorative patterns etched into its surface, and it appears slightly curved with a tapered, pointed tip and a wider, flat base. On the right side, there is a colored drawing of a wooden mortar and pestle. The mortar is rounded with a wider base and a narrower opening, depicted in shades of brown with visible wood grain texture. The pestle is cylindrical and rests inside the mortar, colored similarly in brown. The height and width of the mortar and pestle are labeled as "HEIGHT 7 INS." and "WIDTH 4 1/2 INS." The background is a light beige color, and the drawing is presented on lined sketchbook paper with small black holes along the top edge. The date "10/14/58" and the name "C.D. Johnson" appear at the bottom left of the left section; "10/11/58" and "CHAS. D. CHARDN" are at the bottom right of the right section.
title: Horn and Mortar & Pestle
